price_notice: Rates in this catalogue are illustrative prototype assumptions for planning. They are not supplier quotations, and they are not environmental-impact factors.

boards.name: Standard corrugated board
boards.price_source: PackShift prototype assumption, not a supplier quote
limitations: Single-wall caliper is nominal. Confirm the sheet with the board supplier.

boards.name: Recycled-content corrugated board
boards.price_source: PackShift prototype assumption, not a supplier quote
limitations: Recycled fibre content is not certified here.
A lower board price or grammage is not evidence of a lower environmental impact.

boards.name: Corrugated board with no published rate
limitations: No board rate is loaded, so a cost comparison must stay unavailable.

cushioning.name: No separate insert
cushioning.note: The clearance is an air gap. It is not a tested cushion.

cushioning.name: Foam inserts
cushioning.note: Foam is not scored as less suitable, or more suitable, on environmental grounds. No life-cycle dataset is loaded.

cushioning.name: Molded-fiber inserts
cushioning.note: A paper-based insert is not treated as automatically preferable to foam.

cushioning.name: Paper-based protective inserts
cushioning.note: Paper construction alone is not a recyclability or biodegradability claim.

configurations.name: Standard corrugated board
limitations: For high fragility the clearance is empty space, not a qualified cushion.

configurations.name: Recycled-content corrugated board
limitations: Recycled content is an unverified catalogue label. The sheet is assumed 1 mm thicker.

configurations.name: Corrugated board with foam inserts
limitations: The insert is assumed to occupy the configured clearance. That fit is not a drop-test result.

configurations.name: Corrugated board with molded-fiber inserts
limitations: Molded fiber is assumed to sit in the same clearance. Protection is not certified.

configurations.name: Corrugated board with paper-based protective inserts
limitations: Paper inserts are not labelled more sustainable than foam. Only area, mass, volume and cost are compared.

configurations.name: Corrugated board awaiting a material rate
limitations: Kept out of the default shortlist because the board rate is missing. Geometry can still be calculated.
